A complete rounded square frame surrounds a separate irregular territory outline with clear empty space on all sides.

## Visual draft

A rounded square frame encloses an irregular territory outline with numerous curved inlets and protrusions. The land shape sits independently inside the frame, leaving a wide empty margin on every side.

## 1. Rounded square map frame (container)

An empty square enclosure has straight sides and broad rounded corners. Exclude the inner territory outline.

## 2. Irregular territory outline (sub)

An irregular land boundary has curved inlets, rounded protrusions, and an uneven taper toward its lower right. Exclude the surrounding square frame.
